b'# TinyDL CLI

This tool is used to download content from a URL.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <url> [-o <file>] [-q]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
| :--- | :--- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
